items.title: Machine Learning · multiple-choice
items.lessonContent:
Read the stated letter rule and the supplied word bank before solving.
Use the dictionary clue as support, keeping the selected meaning in mind.
Check every letter and every position rather than relying on a guess.
The uniqueness check applies to the supplied words; definitions come from the cited source.
Share this: explain which constraint ruled out the closest alternative.
items.question:
Topic: machine learning. For compound entries, spaces and hyphens are omitted.
Word bank: CLUSTERING, PARAMETER, FEATURE, ALGORITHM, DATA, BATCH, REGULARIZATION, PREDICTION.
Sort the word bank alphabetically (A to Z). Which word is in position 6?
items.correctExplanation: PARAMETER is the only word in this bank satisfying the stated rule. Dictionary meaning: A numerical quantity characterising a statistical population.
items.incorrectExplanation: Check the complete rule. PARAMETER is the only word in this bank satisfying the stated rule. Dictionary meaning: A numerical quantity characterising a statistical population.

proofs.source: Coverage topic packs v2 / machine learning
proofs.scope: letter constraints within the supplied word bank; dictionary meanings are sourced, not formally proven
